newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse trade boosted by over-the-counter exchange.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse trade boosted by over-the-counter exchange.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed up by 0.32 percent in higher trade boosted by over-the-counter exchanges, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 514.95 from 513.30 on Wednesday.
Total volume was 21.48 million dinars against 1.09 million dinars over the previous session. Over-the-counter exchanges amounted to 20.7 million dinars.

Chemical firm Al-Kimia advanced 1.3 dinar to 49.3 dinars. Chemical firm SPCD gained 1.04 dinar to 36.04. Airliner Tunis Air was up 0.42 dinar to 23 dinars. Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing rose 0.2 dinar to 33.3. Coke and beer bottler SFBT advanced 0.14 dinar to 95.14 dinars.
Palm Beach hotels was down 0.48 dinar to 11.5 dinars.
